Zelenskiy open to Ukraine elections during 60-day ceasefire

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy stated he would organize elections if Russia agrees to a 60-day ceasefire. This announcement was made in an interview with ABC. Meanwhile, Russia has reportedly developed jet-powered drones, giving it an advantage in the conflict, and has announced a battalion composed of Ukrainian "volunteers," whose accounts differ regarding their backgrounds and experiences.
